audience: Kindergarten through Grade 8 learners, families, and teachers
promise: Choose a grade and a skill, then start practicing.

directionsConsidered.name: Mathematics field guide
directionsConsidered.inspiration: Warm editorial workbook and a precise measuring instrument
directionsConsidered.fit: Builds on the existing custom geometry sculpture, Fraunces and Lexend fonts, porcelain surfaces, and copper/teal material cues.

directionsConsidered.name: Arctic instrument panel
directionsConsidered.inspiration: Nord inspired slate, pale blue, and technical grids
directionsConsidered.fit: Would make measurement feel rigorous, but would reduce the established warmth for K-8 learners.

directionsConsidered.name: Botanical learning atlas
directionsConsidered.inspiration: Leaf greens, natural paper, and specimen illustrations
directionsConsidered.fit: Could make math approachable, but would compete with grade-specific color meaning.

directionsConsidered.name: Neo-brutalist workshop
directionsConsidered.inspiration: Hard edges, condensed type, and a maker's bench
directionsConsidered.fit: Would make the hand-drawn illustration and younger-grade flows feel harsh.

narrativeBrief.visualThesis: The Fluency Lab should feel like a beautifully made mathematics field guide: warm paper, dark instrument ink, a single copper cue, and generous space around the learner's work.
narrativeBrief.contentPlan: The page moves from the brand and purpose, to grade choice, to Today / Practice / Explore / Growth, with each section doing one clear job.
narrativeBrief.interactionThesis: Motion stays functional: the existing illustration enters once, the existing sticky section tabs remain available while a long view is explored, and selection changes use a brief reduced-motion-aware transition.

typography.rationale: Preserve the established two-face brand pairing and avoid a new download or dependency.

palette.inspiration: Warm porcelain workbook materials with dark instrument ink and copper measurement marks

motion.behavior: Keep the existing one-time hero illustration entrance.
Keep the active learning section in view with the existing sticky section tabs.
Use a brief transition when grade selection changes.

atmosphere: Retain the existing original math sculpture and quiet measuring linework; keep app surfaces calm without additional gradients or decorative cards.
accessibility: Existing contrast and semantic state tokens remain; grade selection is identified by label and shape as well as color; reduced-motion disables transitions.
